name: bookmark-separator
description: Add separators to your bookmarks bar in Chrome, Edge and Brave.

scripts.build: mkdir -p dist/images && html-minifier-terser --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --minify-css true src/index.html -o dist/index.html && terser src/script.js --compress --mangle --comments false -o dist/script.js && cleancss -o dist/style.css src/style.css && cp src/images/*.png dist/images/
scripts.lint: npm run lint:html && npm run lint:css && npm run lint:js
